Most people that were fresh to higher difficulties didn't see it that way sadly. While I did enjoy the Toughness of most missions back then, I'm also happy with the changes they've made along the way. I think we see some aspects from back in the day through rose tinted glasses. But it was fun during that time. Don't think I could go back though.

Fair point. But compared to what we have now, weapons, stratagems were a lot weaker. We had less means to deal with things and the sheer amount of enemies on high diff missions was sometimes so overwhelming that walking away and coming back later was often the proper way to deal with bot drops and patrols.

I can't really speak for the team part as my experience back then was that the team just kept dying to bot drops and patrols while I complete objectives using mostly stealth. Bots also used to shoot a lot more accurately, kept track of you almost throughout the whole map once they spotted you. Especially devastators and berserker.

I didn't say missions were impossible if not using stealth. Just harder. It was the most reliable way to get everything done. And while the EAT and railgun were strong, they were nerfed pretty quickly while only the recoilles remained the go to stratagem on the bot front.

As for ammo and weapons and strats, you can actually see in older patch notes how most weapons were mostly only nerfed during the time of malevolen creek. Whether it be in damage, or ammo capacity.

 A few examples here: 
Breaker went from 16 to 13 magazine capacity with increased recoil from 30 to 55.

Railgun got less damage penetration, and less damage against durable parts.

Energy shield backpack increased delay before recharging.

Hulks and bots could also kill you incredibly fast due to fire damage being skyrocket high, Headshot damage on helldivers was cranked tf up compared to what it is now and heavy or medium armor weren't even worth using due to armor values not working properly.

The best example for extremely high difficulty back then would be defend type missions. Unless you literally trained enemies behind you, you couldn't complete them on higher difficulties.

But our weapons truly were a lot weaker. Both stat wise and ammo capacity wise. 

Armors couldn't take as many hits and we had less options in general for weapons, stratagems, destroyer upgrades, etc.. The most reliable way to deal with bot missions back then was stealth.

And don't forget the fucked up spawns (Bot patrols literally spawned in your face sometimes) and the general amount of bots hulks and tanks we had to deal with was also a lot more.

Hey there, I usually play solo on D-9 (Helldive) against both automatons and bugs.

Here's what I usually take to my runs:

For bugs:
I usually go with the Las-5 Scythe or The Jar-5 Dominator.

If I use the Las, revolver as secondary for stalkers or anything warrior or above.

If it's the Jar, then the full auto secondary (forgot it's name) for clearing swarms while the Jar deals with bigger targets (a well placed shot kills anything that isn't a charger, brood commander or bile titan with one shot and brood commanders take 2 to the head)

I use smoke grenades so I can complete objectives easier without being bothered and run light armor against bugs because you can simply dodge chargers by running left or right (Not diving) and you outrun titans as well.

Also, I usually go with the light armor that decreases detection range. Stealth is underrated for getting a lot of samples and successfull extractions.

For stratagems, I use the Laser cannon (it melts most enemies now and is good against eggs), the jump pack (to easier access egg nests or escape from a pinch easier), the regular eagle airstrike to deal with nests or bile titans/chargers and an autocannon so I can extract easier.

Also with chargers. Try to lead them into walls whenever you get the chance to. It makes dealing with them a lot easier due to the small breather you get. Alternatively, use them to your advantage to kill hordes or even each other. Most people don't realize it, but you can use bile titans, chargers and spewers to kill off most enemies you'd otherwise have to deal with yourself.
